name: Bryan Valenzuela
medium: Mural · Mixed-media on canvas · Glass installation
summary: Figurative-text artist whose work weaves dense passages of handwritten language into the contours of a human figure. Created the Arden Fair UnchARTed flagship piece in 2021.
suitability: Native to the program. Returning artist would anchor any 2026 cycle.

name: Maren Conrad
summary: Painterly muralist working at architectural scale; signature pieces include the MARRS koi mural and a Lady Bird portrait. Strong civic-minded brand visibility.
suitability: Naturalistic motifs and warm palette read well in family-retail. Proven scale.

name: LC Studio Tutto
summary: Husband-and-wife studio (Lin-Fei Fei + Cody) producing painterly, place-attentive commissions. Bright Underbelly underpass and Memory of a Tree are signature wins.
suitability: Place-conscious approach is a strong fit for a Sacramento-anchored mall identity.

name: Jaya King
summary: Quilted-pattern muralist (21st Tapestry, Franklin NDC) and exhibiting encaustic painter. Pattern work has a refined, design-savvy feel.
suitability: Pattern-led abstraction suits a non-figurative anchor wall well.

name: Micah Crandall-Bear
summary: Color-field horizon abstractions — atmospheric, gallery-grade canvases. Less mural-oriented but highly purchasable.
suitability: Better for rotating gallery walls or hospitality-tier interiors than for permanent murals.

name: Gale Hart
summary: Multidisciplinary; Missing the Mark (Golden 1 Center darts) sets the tone — pop-conceptual with a sharp wit.
suitability: Conceptual edge may be too sharp for a family mall — selective use only.

name: Stephanie Taylor
summary: Long-time Sacramento public-mural artist; Dance: A Tribute and a roster of city-historical pieces.
suitability: Civic-leaning storytelling — a heritage-tone counterweight to the contemporary roster.

name: Franceska Gamez
summary: Floral-portraiture and phoenix iconography; Wide Open Walls and Branded Arts roster artist.
suitability: Lush palette translates well to high-traffic walls; Branded Arts rep simplifies booking.

name: Anthony Padilla
summary: Aerosol-trained character & abstract muralist; vibrant, kid-friendly when leveraged that way.
suitability: Character work is family-mall friendly; can scale to corridor-length pieces.

name: John S. Huerta
medium: Mural · Día de los Muertos imagery
summary: Frida Kahlo mural at 24th & K is the calling-card piece; broad Día de los Muertos and Latin-cultural visual vocabulary.
suitability: Strong cultural-moment programming — pair with a fall / Día de los Muertos activation.

name: Waylon Horner
summary: Cartoonish, dream-logic mural work — has the brightness of a Saturday-morning aesthetic with adult composition.
suitability: High family-readability; great fit for entrance murals or food-court anchors.

name: Skinner
summary: Best known for dense mythological imagery; we curate to his lighter, pop-bright work for a family-mall audience. Avoid the heavier metal-adjacent pieces.
suitability: Curate carefully — strong fit if focused on pop-creature pieces, weak if dark mythology surfaces.

name: Groundswell Art
medium: Gallery curation · Hospitality + multifamily art programs
summary: Art consultancy + gallery (Eleanor Apartments install, Fort Sutter Hotel gallery). Strong roster reach across the Sacramento-rooted artist pool.
suitability: Best-in-region curator for a mall-scale program — consider as a primary partner.

name: Wide Open Walls
summary: Sacramento's annual mural festival; managed many of the best-known downtown murals. Strong artist pipeline and event-marketing engine.
suitability: Excellent if program is event-led; can deliver multi-artist mural week tied to a festival cycle.

name: NINE dot ARTS
summary: National art-consulting agency with deep hospitality/multifamily/corporate experience. Bigger budgets and longer timelines than local agencies.
suitability: Use only if scope expands beyond Sacramento-local artists — national reach but lower local rooting.

name: Ink and Indigo
summary: Represented through Kevin Barry Art Advisory; pattern-driven ink and indigo work with decorative appeal but unverified Sacramento ties or mural-scale experience.
suitability: Decorative ink-and-indigo palette would read warmly in family-retail settings, but Sacramento connection and public-art scale are unconfirmed through the advisory listing.

name: Susannah Mira
kind: Artist · Texas (via Kevin Barry Art Advisory)
summary: Texas-based sculptor working in reclaimed materials and large-scale installation; represented by Kevin Barry Art Advisory.
suitability: Reclaimed-material installations read as inventive and family-legible, but no clear Sacramento tie. Would require advisory liaison and travel logistics for mall-scale commission.
